# Karl's Tools

> A Hugo-powered site of small, self-contained tools (mostly browser-based) for quick tasks.

Tools are organized by language under `/tools/`. Each tool page embeds a single-file tool (inline JS/CSS when HTML).
Most tools run entirely in the browser and are designed for local, private use.

## Site

- [Home](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/): Landing page with tool cards.
- [Tools index](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/tools/): Browse all tools.
- [HTML tools](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/tools/html/): HTML/JS browser tools.
- [Python tools](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/tools/python/): Python-based tools.
- [About](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/about/): Brief background on the site.
- [Analytics](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/analytics/): Local-only analytics description.

## Tools

The full tool list is generated in a dedicated file:

- [tools.txt](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/tools.txt)

## Optional

- [Analytics UI](https://tools.karlquinsland.com/analytics.html): View/export/clear local analytics data.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kquinsland/tools): Hugo source, tool files, and build scripts.
